# Sierra

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/sierra.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Companies](../README.md#companies)

AI-native products · International · Loop reviewed 2026-09-29

In April 2026 Sierra rebuilt its engineering interviews around coding agents: a system design screen, then an onsite where the candidate plans, builds and defends a product in about two hours with the AI tools of their choice. Earlier loops, reported by a candidate, used a take-home agent build.

On this page: [Interview loop](#loop) · [Official preparation material](#prep) · [Questions (4)](#questions)

## Roles covered

- **AI Engineering:** Agent engineer, Software engineer on AI products

## <a id="loop"></a>Interview loop

| Stage | What happens | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| System design screen<br>*Software engineer on AI products* | Replaced the earlier coding screen, in which candidates wrote code without AI: the company considers taking an application into production at scale the harder problem. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29 |
| Onsite: plan<br>*Software engineer on AI products* | A working session in which the candidate drives the definition of a product in their own domain while interviewers question it. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29 |
| Onsite: build<br>*Software engineer on AI products* | The interviewer leaves and the candidate builds the product for about two hours with the AI tools and frameworks of their choice, free to cut or change scope. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29 |
| Onsite: review<br>*Software engineer on AI products* | A demo and a debate of the key product flows; a code review of the data model, abstractions and extensibility; the path to production; and how AI was used. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29 |
| Debugging interview (pilot)<br>*Software engineer on AI products* | A medium-sized codebase and a colleague's draft pull request that adds a cross-cutting feature: review and improve it, iterating with coding agents. How much AI is allowed was still undecided. | ✅ confirmed by the company<br>[The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29 |
| Earlier take-home and onsite<br>*Agent engineer* | One candidate, about a year before retrieval: build a customer-support agent for a fictional company, choosing two of five features and explaining how to measure it in production; then a TypeScript and React debugging round and a defence of the design. | 🗣 candidate report<br>[Sierra AI Agent Engineer Interview Experience](https://www.tryexponent.com/experiences/sierra-ai-machine-learning-engineer-interview-8549fc), Aced (formerly Exponent), candidate report, retrieved 2026-09-29 |

**Coding:** required. The build round is hands-on programming with AI tools allowed. ([The AI-native interview](https://sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview), Sierra, published 2026-04-22, retrieved 2026-09-29)

## <a id="questions"></a>Questions reported for Sierra

### [Agents, tools and protocols](../themes/agents-tools.md)

- **[Build a customer-support agent for a fictional company: choose two of five proposed features, justify the choice and explain how you would measure the agent in production.](../themes/agents-tools.md#agt-support-agent-takehome)**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: Sierra 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you prioritise scope under a deadline and plan measurement for a working agent.

### [Practical coding](../themes/coding-practical.md)

- **[Plan a product with the interviewer, then build it in about two hours with the AI coding tools of your choice and defend its design, code and path to production.](../themes/coding-practical.md#code-ai-assisted-build)**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: Sierra ✅
  - Tests: Whether you scope, build and defend a working product with AI assistance under a time limit.
- **[Review and improve a colleague's draft pull request that adds a cross-cutting feature to an unfamiliar codebase, working alongside coding agents.](../themes/coding-practical.md#code-agent-pr-review)**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: Sierra ✅
  - Tests: Whether you judge someone else's change critically instead of accepting what an agent proposes.
- **[In a spreadsheet where cells can reference other cells, detect whether there is a circular reference.](../themes/coding-practical.md#code-spreadsheet-cycles)**
  - Coding · Asked at: Sierra 🗣
  - Tests: Whether you model dependencies as a graph and detect cycles correctly and efficiently.
